scripts.stop: lsof -ti :3001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti :3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'wwebjs_auth' 2>/dev/null; echo '✅ All processes stopped'
scripts.dev: concurrently --names ENGINE,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:engine" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.restart: npm run stop && sleep 2 && npm run dev
